*   An annual water heater flush and inspection.
*   An annual whole-home plumbing inspection.
*   15% off plumbing repairs.

For a Trane compressor on a system that is three years old, the manufacturer's parts warranty typically covers the compressor for 10 years, provided the system was registered. This covers the cost of the part itself, but not the labor to replace it.

Regarding labor coverage:
* Meridian provides a 2-year labor warranty on new system installations.
* If you were a Comfort Club member at the time of installation, this labor warranty is extended to 5 years.

Since your system is three years old, labor would be covered if you were a Comfort Club member when it was installed. Otherwise, the labor warranty has expired. The typical range for compressor replacement labor when the part is under warranty is $600 to $900, and the technician confirms the exact pricing on site.

If you would like to book a repair visit, I can help with that. Is there any burning smell, smoke, sparks or a tripped breaker?
